exe.title: Sync tool
exe.text: Windows program that sends the loot from the game to EventHelper.

zip.title: WoW addon
zip.text: The in-game addon: collects loot and guild bank.

install.title: First installation
install.zip1: Unzip it. The folder "EventHelperSync" goes into "<WoW>/_anniversary_/Interface/AddOns/" (TBC Anniversary) or "<WoW>/_classic_beta_/Interface/AddOns/" (WoW Forever).
install.zip2: Start the game, or type "/reload" in game.
install.zip3: Check in the addon menu that "EventHelperSync" is enabled.
install.exe1: Start EventHelperSync.exe with a double click.
install.exe2: Enter the server address and API token. You create the token under Settings → Loot sync.
install.update: From version 1.14.0 the sync tool updates itself and installs the addon with the "Install" button. You only need this page for the first installation.
